players.product: Front-end photoresist coater/developer tracks (offline, I-line, KrF, ArF immersion), front-end single-wafer chemical and physical cleaning tools, and advanced-packaging coater/developer, wet and temporary bonding/debonding tools

quarterly_data.signal: Chairman Dong Boyu (H1 2026 results briefing): H1 new orders kept growing fast, with both back-end high-end packaging (represented by HBM and CoWoS) and the new front-end chemical cleaner posting good year-on-year growth; by order mix, back-end to front-end was roughly four to six, with the front-end share still rising. Contract liabilities at end-June were flat year on year because about 50% of H1 new orders were concentrated in May-June; he said the balance will grow from July as those orders land and payments are collected. Executive committee chairman Deng Xiaojun said revenue typically lags orders by 6 to 12 months or more.
quarterly_data.figure: about 50% of H1 2026 new orders signed in May-June; revenue lags orders by 6 to 12 months or more

quarterly_data.signal: Chairman Dong Boyu (H1 2026 results briefing): in H1 the front-end share of revenue rose further and is now roughly even with back-end high-end packaging; front-end cleaning was over 30% of revenue and is increasingly important as the second growth curve; front-end Track contributed some revenue, and its main 2026 work is validating new models - once they pass, he expects its market share to keep rising next year and the year after. H1 gross margin was roughly flat to slightly down year on year: front-end product margins rose while back-end packaging margins fell because the company gave price concessions to some strategic customers on back-end tools, and those lower-margin orders turned into revenue in H1; it is pushing back-end cost reduction to keep margins reasonable. He said profit is under temporary pressure as orders and revenue ramp and expects the overall profit margin to improve as revenue grows. With NAURA's support the company aims for a rapid front-end Track breakthrough this year and next; executive committee chairman Deng Xiaojun called 2026 the big validation year for its new front-end coater/developer models and expects to benefit for several years from customers' expansion and rising localisation, noting that overseas tools still hold a very high share of China's front-end coater/developer market.
quarterly_data.figure: front-end cleaning over 30% of H1 2026 revenue

quarterly_data.signal: Executive committee chairman Deng Xiaojun (H1 2026 results briefing): overall production pressure is heavy - first floor space, for which capacity expansion is under way, and second staff, as designing, building and commissioning the orders strains the workforce, so the company will keep adding people to match order growth. Component supply is broadly stable, but some imported materials have longer lead times, which the company covers with strategic stock and advance purchases to keep production and delivery normal. Chairman Dong Boyu said the capacity expansion plan is proceeding in order.

Board secretary Liu Shujie (H1 2026 results briefing): the main plant of the raised-fund high-end wafer processing equipment industrialisation project (phase II) has topped out and the building exterior is under construction; after a prudent review of actual progress the company plans to adjust the project's ready-for-use date to December 8, 2027, without changing its investment content, use, scale or implementing entity.
quarterly_data.figure: phase II project ready-for-use date adjusted to December 8, 2027
